test_title: PYST 07: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct to Indirect Speech.

They said, "How foolish of him to say that!"

options.text: They exclaimed how foolish of him to say that.
They exclaimed that it had been very foolish of him to say that.
They exclaimed that he is very foolish to say that.
They said it was very foolish of him to say that.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** They exclaimed how foolish of him to say that.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **Exclamation:**
 
 
• Direct speech exclamation "How foolish of him to say that!" is converted to "They exclaimed how foolish of him to say that."
 
• The tone of surprise and criticism is maintained.
 
 
 
• **Reporting Verb:**
 
 
• Direct speech reporting verb "said" is converted to "exclaimed" to match the exclamatory tone.
 
 
 
• **Tense:**
 
 
• Since the sentence is universal in nature, tense remains unchanged.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech exclamation is removed.
 
• Sentence is restructured to fit indirect speech format.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"They exclaimed how foolish of him to say that."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "They exclaimed that it had been very foolish of him to say that." 

 
 
• Incorrect tense conversion changes the meaning unnecessarily.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "They exclaimed that he is very foolish to say that."
 
 
• Incorrect tense (present tense "is" instead of past tense).
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "They said it was very foolish of him to say that."
 
 
• Fails to convey the exclamatory tone.
